body:
> Sounds like:
> 
> * [RichTextLabel: Newly Instanced RichTextLabel's add_text() and append_text() don't add to text #94630](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/94630)

I looked at that issue too, but in my understanding it's a different topic. That issue revolves around how the text property is not updated with add_text (and I got it why), but the label is still showing correctly. I just tested it: I put the text += operation at the beginning (because it will clear the tag stack otherwise), and I gave the new label some size, and it works correctly, even if the text property is not the same as the text shown:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a5e4a8b2-415e-472a-a1e0-6c82b53274f0)

In my issue, if the RTL is orphan, it doesn't show the things added with add_*(); I'm not considering the text property at all.

Problem still occurs on `v4.5.dev.custom_build [215acd52e]`. Removing the suggested code above does not seem to resolve the issue. ~~Placing a breakpoint in `RichTextLabel::add_text` never seems to get hit by the game code, only by calls from `EditorLog::_add_log_line` which I believe is engine internal, so some more digging is required here.~~ (I forgot the debugger doesn't carry through when running a scene from a debugged editor, so I need to run the game directly instead to get more information)

```
Godot v4.5.dev (215acd52e) - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 570.133.07) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)
```

cc @AThousandShips for bug triage

My sample case (using the `rich_text_label.tscn` from the MRP):
```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
	var label: RichTextLabel = preload("res://rich_text_label.tscn").instantiate()
	label.text = "Initial text."
	label.add_text("More text")
	add_child(label)
```

Call order to `add_text` in this case:
1. With `p_text = "Initial text."`, originating from an implicit call to `set_text` as a result of the GDScript assignment (which calls `_apply translation`)
2. With `p_text = "More text"`, originating from a call to `add_text` in GDScript
3. With `p_text = "Initial text."`, originating from a call to `_apply_translation` in the notification handler for `NOTIFICATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED` in RichTextLabel, itself originating from the notification handler for `NOTIFICATION_POST_ENTER_TREE` in RichTextLabel

Changing the script so that the call to `add_text` comes after the call to `add_child` results in the same calls but with 2 and 3 swapped in the order.

`_apply_translation` takes the current value of the `text` attribute and then calls `parse_bbcode` with it, which contains a call to clear. At this point, `text` only contains `"Initial text."` and not the added text, so the `add_text` call with `"More text"` is lost. It is only meant to do this if `stack_externally_modified` is false, otherwise it queues a redraw. However, it does not seem like `stack_externally_modified = true` is set by the call to `add_text`, which seems to only be added by `_add_item` or `remove_paragraph`, and `_add_item` does not seem to be being called in this case.

Will need some more time to debug and find out how best to fix this.
